summary.text: Shannon Bray is the Libertarian nominee for the open U.S. Senate seat in North Carolina. A U.S. Navy veteran who works in information technology and software development, he says he is known in the cryptography and blockchain fields. He has run statewide as a Libertarian before: for U.S. Senate in 2020 and 2022 and for lieutenant governor in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Bray was born in Marrero, Louisiana, and graduated from Thibodaux High School. He served in the U.S. Navy from 1991 to 1997.
He later earned an associate degree from Arapahoe Community College in 2014, a bachelor's degree from Colorado State University in 2016 and a graduate degree from the University of Delaware in 2018.

Bray's professional experience includes information technology, software development, information security and management, and he has been associated with the Coast Guard Auxiliary, the Naval Sea Cadet Corps and the Navy League.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he describes himself as an author, speaker and professional coach who lives in Apex, North Carolina, with his wife and three children.
As the Libertarian candidate, Bray received 3.1% of the vote for U.S. Senate in 2020 and 1.4% in 2022, and 1.9% for lieutenant governor in 2024.
For 2026 he advanced to the general election without a Libertarian primary contest.
